mapper.insert: INSERT INTO batch_customer_export SELECT #{job}, #{run}, #{artifact}, c.id, 0, c.name, c.email, c.status, c.updated_at, c.version, NULL FROM customer c

INSERT INTO batch_customer_export SELECT #{job},#{run},'customers',c.id,0,c.name,c.email,c.status,c.updated_at,c.version,NULL FROM customer c JOIN batch_input_work w ON w.customer_id=c.id WHERE w.job_name=#{job} AND w.run_id=#{run}

INSERT INTO batch_input_work (job_name,run_id,file_index,ordinal,customer_id,name,email,status,expected_version) SELECT s.job_name,s.run_id,0,s.ordinal,s.id_text::bigint,s.name,s.email,s.status,c.version FROM batch_copy_stage s LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.id=s.id_text::bigint WHERE s.job_name=#{job} AND s.run_id=#{run}

INSERT INTO batch_customer_export SELECT #{job}, #{run}, 'customer-members', c.id, COALESCE(m.member_id,0), c.name, c.email, c.status, c.updated_at, c.version, m.tier FROM customer c LEFT JOIN membership m ON m.customer_id=c.id

INSERT INTO batch_input_work (job_name, run_id, file_index, ordinal, customer_id, name, email, status, expected_version) VALUES (#{job}, #{run}, #{fileIndex}, #{ordinal}, #{customerId}, #{name}, #{email}, #{status}, COALESCE(#{expectedVersion,jdbcType=BIGINT}, (SELECT version FROM customer WHERE id=#{customerId})))
INSERT INTO batch_input_error (job_name,run_id,file_index,ordinal,reason) VALUES (#{job},#{run},#{fileIndex},#{ordinal},#{error}) ON CONFLICT (job_name,run_id,file_index,ordinal) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: WITH changed AS ( UPDATE customer c SET name=w.name,email=w.email,status=w.status, version=c.version + CASE WHEN (c.name,c.email,c.status) IS DISTINCT FROM (w.name,w.email,w.status) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, updated_at=CASE WHEN (c.name,c.email,c.status) IS DISTINCT FROM (w.name,w.email,w.status) THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE c.updated_at END FROM batch_input_work w WHERE w.job_name=#{job} AND w.run_id=#{run} AND c.id=w.customer_id AND c.version=w.expected_version RETURNING c.id ), added AS ( INSERT INTO customer(id,name,email,status) SELECT customer_id,name,email,status FROM batch_input_work WHERE job_name=#{job} AND run_id=#{run} AND expected_version IS NULL ORDER BY customer_id ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id ) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM changed) + (SELECT count(*) FROM added)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer (id,name,email,status,updated_at,version) SELECT id, 'customer-' || id || '-' || substring( md5((id * 17 + #{seed})::text) || md5((id * 19 + #{seed})::text) || repeat(md5((id * 23 + #{seed})::text),128),1,#{width}-48), CASE WHEN id % 10 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE id || '@example.test' END, CASE WHEN id % 10 = 0 THEN 'INACTIVE' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END, TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00' + (id % 86400) * INTERVAL '1 second',0 FROM generate_series(#{start}::bigint,#{end}::bigint) AS id ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING
